thread:
Priya: FYI — we just got an alert, a recent migration rollback is impacting SSO handshakes for a subset of onboarding tenants. Seeing auth failures and stalled provisioning. Triage call in 15? :warning:
Liam: On it. Can you drop the list of affected tenants? rough count?
Priya: ~42 tenants across EU + US regions. Most are mid-market trial/onboarders. I'll link the query in a sec.
Evan: SRE update — rollback introduced a header validation mismatch with our identity proxy. We're patching a compatibility shim now, ETA 25-40m. Root cause: token format change in the previous deploy.
Priya: Ok — we need a customer-facing comm for affected tenants: short status, ETA, mitigating steps, and a goodwill credit proposal. Draft in thread so AMs can copy. @Carlos can you help with segmentation and priority list? :email:
Carlos: I have the priority list (enterprise + high-touch trial). Pushing to the doc. For enterprise accounts we should offer direct POC + a 2-week credit; for SMB/trial maybe 7-day credit + setup help.
Liam: Technical note for comm: don't say 'rollback' — say 'we reverted a recent platform update' and focus on mitigation and ETA. Also include recommended temporary workaround: users can use API key auth instead of SSO while we fix.
Priya: Good call. Draft below — please iterate.
Priya: ```Subject: Update: temporary SSO disruption for some onboarding customers

Hi <Customer name>,

We're reaching out with an update: earlier today we reverted a platform update that affected SSO sign-ins for a small number of onboarding customers. Our engineers are actively working on a compatibility patch and we expect full resolution within 1 hour.

What we're doing:
• Rolling a compatibility shim to restore SSO handshakes (in progress)
• Providing an alternate auth path (API key) for immediate access
• Monitoring your tenant and will notify you as soon as SSO is restored

If you'd like hands-on help while we restore SSO, reply to this message and we'll schedule a 30-minute support session.

Compensation: We recognize this impacts your onboarding experience. We're offering a pro-rated credit: enterprise accounts: 2 weeks of committed capacity; trials/SMB: 7 days of credits. Please let us know if you'd prefer a direct onboarding session instead.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this is disruptive and appreciate your patience.

Best,
The Redwood Onboarding Team
```
Priya: Notes: keep <Customer name> tokenized for AMs to personalize.
Nina: Legal OK on the wording and credit tiers. Please avoid promising SLA-level refunds; 'pro-rated credit' is fine.
Carlos: Segmentation: I'm flagging 8 enterprise accounts as priority outreach (call + email). I'll assign AMs in the sheet. For the 34 SMB/trial tenants we'll send the templated email and provide office hours links.
Evan: Quick technical snippet for the email if you want to include: ``If you need immediate access, create an API key at https://console.redwood.ai/account/keys and use header Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>.`` Should we include that?
Priya: Yes — include as an inline "temporary workaround" section, but add a short warning that API keys bypass SSO so rotate keys later.
Liam: Also include a link to the incident page: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-4012 for transparency.
CommBot: Incident INC-4012 status changed: mitigation in progress -> partial mitigation (compatibility shim deployed to 3 of 6 clusters).
Priya: Assignments:
• @Carlos — final priority list + AM assignments, send enterprise outreach within 20m
• @Liam — confirm workaround copy and link to console keys
• @Evan — update ETA and post when full mitigation completes
• @Nina — hold on legal for any customer escalation language
• @Priya — consolidate customer communications and post final template to the CS playbook

Evan: Patch progress: shim deployed to EU-1 and US-2 clusters, error rates down 78% for affected tenants. Continuing rollout now.
Carlos: Enterprise outreach draft done for first 4 accounts. Sending via DM to assigned AMs for personalization.
Priya: Quick Q: credit approval — finance ok with the proposed tiers? Nina said legal ok, but finance sign-off?
Nina: I pinged Finance Slack channel — waiting on final sign-off but we can provisionally offer the credits; finalize numbers after finance confirms.
Liam: Heads up — one tenant reported a web-console redirect loop even after shim. Evan can follow-up.
Evan: Noted — adding that tenant to hot list. Will escalate to on-call infra if loop persists after full rollout.
Priya: Final copy I'm going to push to the playbook after a quick pass. Posting final templated email here in 10m and adding CSV of affected tenants for AMs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
